Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/render.tsx:57

One slide's inner content — a with the item's CDN src (folder + src), intrinsic size for aspect-ratio layout, and the expand/video/label flags. Returns null for placeholder entries. classes/class are both set — the custom-element attribute and the rendered class list must match for the Safari CSS path.

Slide descriptor, or null for empty slots.
